$comment: Shared ability pool. Mirrors SPEC.md section 8. 'effect' is design intent in prose; there is no engine yet to encode it against.

abilities.name: Kindling
abilities.effect: The first attack of the battle deals 1.5x damage.

abilities.name: Tidewater
abilities.effect: Heals 1/8 of max HP at end of turn while above half HP.

abilities.name: Bedrock
abilities.effect: Cannot be KO'd from full HP in one hit; survives at 1 HP.

abilities.name: Brawny
abilities.effect: +3 ATK.

abilities.name: Sharp Mind
abilities.effect: +3 SpA.

abilities.name: Thick Hide
abilities.effect: +3 DEF.

abilities.name: Steady
abilities.effect: +3 SpD.

abilities.name: Quick Feet
abilities.effect: +3 SPD.

abilities.name: Overgrown
abilities.effect: +10% max HP.

abilities.name: Fireproof
abilities.effect: Cannot be burned.

abilities.name: Anchored
abilities.effect: Cannot be switched out or moved.

abilities.name: Clear Head
abilities.effect: Immune to confusion and to stat drops.

abilities.name: Cold Blood
abilities.effect: Immune to Dark intimidate effects.

abilities.name: Grounded
abilities.effect: Immune to Earth hazards.

abilities.name: Drink Deep
abilities.effect: Water moves heal instead of damaging.

abilities.name: Ember Heart
abilities.effect: Fire moves heal instead of damaging.

abilities.name: Mind Sponge
abilities.effect: Psychic hits raise SpA instead of damaging.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.effect: Moves first on the turn it enters.

abilities.name: Slow Burn
abilities.effect: Always moves last; deals +20% damage.

abilities.name: Windup
abilities.effect: -3 SPD; moves first on every 3rd turn.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.effect: Below 1/3 HP, ATK and SpA are raised 50%.

abilities.name: Thorns
abilities.effect: An attacker making contact takes 1/8 of its own max HP.

abilities.name: Grudge
abilities.effect: On being KO'd, the killing move loses all remaining uses.

abilities.name: Colony
abilities.effect: Has bodies instead of HP; each body lost is one fewer hit it can make.

abilities.name: Royal
abilities.effect: Allied Swarm mons regain one body at end of turn.

abilities.name: Built
abilities.effect: Immune to poison, burn and sleep; takes 1.5x damage from Water.

abilities.name: Unreal
abilities.effect: Immune to Normal moves.

abilities.name: Lucky Day
abilities.effect: On any turn whose count is a multiple of 7, always moves first and always crits.
